applicabilityBasis.summary: EJPY is a pre-launch trust-type yen stablecoin planned for 1:1 JPY redemption under Japan's Payment Services Act framework.

references.label: Japan Blockchain Foundation EJPY proof-of-concept program

genius.notes: Evidence reviewed 2026-10-07: EJPY remains a planned Japanese trust-type yen token designed for payments, settlement and remittance. The May 13 announcement identifies Japan Blockchain Foundation Co., Ltd. as the prospective settlor, with discussions with prospective trustees ongoing; it does not establish JBFD as the legally obligated token issuer. The September 24 pilot announcement offers EJPY test coins and says trust structure, issuance/redemption processes and legal compliance remain in preparation. Therefore issuerEntity and licensingRegulator have been removed as unsupported current legal-issuer/license claims; The proposed issuance jurisdiction is Japan; issuerDomicile is omitted because the legally obligated issuer is unresolved. Apparent-payment-stablecoin describes the proposed design, not a launched token or finalized redemption obligation. No live reserve disclosure, binding public redemption policy or monthly attestation was found. No token-specific public U.S. GENIUS approval, official application, registered foreign exception or announced GENIUS route was located. Substantive federal rules remain proposed.

sourcesChecked: OCC Bulletin 2026-3, reopened 2026-10-07: proposed issuer and foreign-registration framework, not a token approval.

OCC Digital Assets Licensing Applications, direct HTTPS/HTML table extraction on 2026-10-07: nine pending charter applicants, none matching this token or identified issuer; this table is not an exhaustive GENIUS register.
Treasury August 17 section 3 proposal (sb0605), reopened 2026-10-07: expected January 18, 2027 effectiveness and separate DASP implementation dates.
September 30 SCRC procedural interim final rule, reopened 2026-10-07: procedures do not certify a state regime or qualify this issuer.
Federal Reserve September 24 proposals and Public Law 119-27, reopened 2026-10-07: functional payment-stablecoin definition and proposed implementation.

Public search on 2026-10-07 for IDRT, IDRX, EJPY and GMO-Z.com Trust with GENIUS, PPSI, enforcement or registration across OCC, Treasury, NYDFS, FDIC, NCUA, Federal Reserve, SEC, CFTC and FinCEN domains. No exact token-specific GENIUS approval, application, registration or enforcement result located; unrelated biotechnology IDRx results excluded.
https://www.jbfd.org/en/news/joc-ejpy - May 13 trust-type proposal, prospective settlor and ongoing trustee discussions; no offering announced.
https://www.jbfd.org/news/stablecoin-poc-partners - September 24 test-token proof-of-concept program and continuing issuance/redemption/legal preparation.
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, no public U.S. GENIUS PPSI approval, state qualification, official application, registered foreign exception or issuer-announced GENIUS route was located for the planned EJPY project in the opened issuer and regulator sources. JBFD is identified as the prospective settlor; the legally obligated trustee/issuer is not publicly identified by the reviewed announcements, so a token issuer cannot be matched to an authorization.
